title: Research: length-≤2 dest-in diverge census — four #3696 rejects not exhaustive (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers open question 2 of [#3696](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3696) under the [#2977](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2977)/[#3004](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3004) checker/exporter cascade. That PR showed dest-free gates always make Sym and Exp agree, named dest-in witnesses that diverge, and four B[0] `bad operands` rejects. OQ2 asked whether those four rejects are exhaustive for dest-in-sources divergence on the pinned word.

They are not. On the pinned tuned word, at B[0] destination `d=111` over `n=661` registers, Sym≠Exp for exactly **661** source lists of length at most 2 — namely all `[a,d]`. Only `self_even` and `dest_with_src` among the four named rejects lie in that set; `dup_src` and `self_once` agree.

This package also proves a dest-in closed form: Sym and Exp agree iff either `d ∉ srcs`, or else `count(d)` is odd and every non-`d` value has even multiplicity in the strict prefix before the last `d`. Dest-free agreement is used inside that form and is not republished as the claim. Every length-≤2 divergence fails operand distinctness and is rejected by the checker.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. No production/schema adoption.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion/`
- Tip: `8db402376a5604dcccd9a4db9072313253595f2d`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **changed** — answer #3696 OQ2 with closed form + exact length-≤2 census

Closest prior: open [#3696](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3696). Soft overlap is a semantic successor (token ≈0.10 / line ≈0.33), not a ~0.9 dest-free retarget and not the deferred dest-absent corollary. Cascade priors #2977/#3004 leave alone.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_WORD_REJECT_EXHAUSTION len2_divergences=661 named_diverge=2 four_exhaustive=false no_new_kappa
PASS_SELECTED_WORD_REJECT_INDEPENDENT len2_divergences=661 named_diverge=2 four_exhaustive=false
PASS_SELECTED_WORD_REJECT_PACKAGE_TESTS
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-word-reject-exhaustion outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

2. Should schema docs separate divergence classes from distinctness rejects?
